items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I worked there with Tad Dameron's band.

ctx.x: Yeah, I worked there with Tad Dameron's band. Thank you for mentioning that. I worked above with Tad, and he wanted -- he had an idea that he wanted a guitar lead on all of his -- most of his arrangements. So he wrote quite a few things and on top of all the voicings there would be the guitar. And as a matter of fact we did quite a few recordings with this, and one of the records won an award for the record of the year. It was called Focus and John's Delight, which I wrote.
